steps.prompt: Find who edwinspire is on GitHub. Use run_command with curl to https://api.github.com/users/edwinspire to get the profile and give me a summary (username, name, bio, location, public repos, followers, profile link).

harness.text:
Based on the data retrieved from the GitHub API, here is a summary of **edwinspire**:

- **Username:** Edwin De La Cruz
- **Name:** Edwin De La Cruz
- **Bio:** (None)
- **Location:** Quito, Ecuador
- **Public Repos:** 56
- **Followers:** 4
- **Profile Link:** https://github.com/edwinspire

**Source:** [GitHub API - Users Profile](https://api.github.com/users/edwinspire)
